title: NO, NOT ONE!
author: Johnson Oatman, Jr, and George C. Hugg
stanzas: There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus, No, not one! No not one! None else could heal all our soul's diseases, No, not one! No, not One!
No friend like Him is so high and holy, No not one! No not one! And yet no friend is so meek anf lowly, No, not one! No, not one!
Did ever saint find this saint forsake him? No, not one! No not one! Or sinner find that He could not take hin? No, not one! No, not one!
Was e'er a gift like the savior given? No, not one! No, not one! Will He refuse us a home in heaven? No, not one! No, not one!
chorus: Jesus knows all about our struggles, He will guide till the the day is done; Theres's not a friend like the lowly Jesus, No, not one! No, not one!
